title: Decode actual PDF cells and layout in the shared canonical output comparator
description: Stage 2 shared migration engine only; preserve all old routes, four-stage gate, user row/column/menu/data-scope permissions and concurrent work. No arbitrary SQL/joins, independent report, new database/schema, production access/deployment or fabricated proof. Retain exact failure/audit evidence and existing execution budget/cancellation. An authorized migration reviewer must compare actual canonical legacy and generic PDF bytes. Implement a bounded managed PDF decoder (existing PdfSharp or a minimal maintained primary-source dependency) for Unicode/CMap text, ordered headers, cell text/null representation, currency/unit labels, page/band continuation and layout boundaries. Use actual decoded content from both artifacts; input snapshots are cross-checks only. Remove the deliberate unsupported-PDF block only for supported decoded structures; malformed/encrypted/images-only/unextractable/font/oversize cases remain accurately blocked. Do not use external machine paths as parser dependencies or raw compressed bytes/font markers as proof. Compare differently paginated legitimate column bands semantically without losing columns. Record precise comparison reasons and isolated SQL/artifact evidence.
implementation_evidence: 383b8c0 regression Pdf_with_different_actual_cells showed DIFFERENT PDF cells accepted with EXPECTED input snapshots; ComparePdfArtifacts now correctly returns false because DecodePdf exposes no cells/layout. ERP333 completed build but actual PDF capability is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Actual PDF decoding compares real ordered cells/headers and currency/unit/layout; changed cell, missing header or band/page truncation rejects even with matching input snapshots.

Identical supported actual canonical/generic PDFs can match; encrypted, malformed, unsupported glyph mapping or extraction and resource overflow fail closed with accurate reasons and current permissions unchanged.

Prove supported positive and negative cases with real generated PDF bytes and guarded isolated SQL data; safe Release build/unit suite plus scheduler self-test/contracts pass; missing browser/full-family parity remains recorded, no stage completion claim.
